result_json.message:
Add the schema 1 plan-contract implementation plan.

Approved runs currently treat every non-checkbox plan edit as drift. The plan specifies a governing projection and a recorded 0-to-1 migration so living-plan edits can proceed without resetting approval.
docs: add plan review for plan schema contracts and migration

items.title: Schema 1 text-amendment guard verification fails after any informational edit
items.reason: Guards anchor to raw authorized lineage bytes (implementation-review-context.ts:552) and verifyGuardedPlanBytes compares raw bytes outside spans; schema 1 informational edits make every later text amendment and guarded author admission fail with PLAN_AMENDMENT_OUT_OF_SPAN, contradicting requirement 6. Plan only acknowledges the after-snapshot case.
items.failure: On a schema 1 run, once a status line or note is edited, no text_only plan amendment can be verified and guarded author steps are blocked, so execution stalls.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Choose and specify a schema-1 guard verification rule (projection-based fixed-segment check or accepting raw diffs only on non-governing lines), apply it to the unchanged check, and add status/note-then-amendment fixtures.

items.title: authorityMarkdown blanking contradicts offset preservation
items.reason: Doc comment says non-governing lines become empty (shifting offsets) while design says raw offsets stay valid; protectedPlanByteRanges converts char to byte offsets from the string it is given, which is wrong on a mask with blanked non-ASCII text.
items.failure: Plan-impact spans and protected ranges resolve to wrong raw byte offsets, authorizing or rejecting the wrong bytes.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Specify blanking as replacing each non-newline UTF-16 code unit with a space (keeping CR/LF) and converting char ranges to bytes via the raw string; add a non-ASCII fixture.

items.title: recover-plan earlier-phase section equality remains raw on schema 1
items.reason: implementation-recovery.ts ~299-320 compares raw earlier-phase slices; the plan converts lines 266/327/329 but not this comparison. Notes in completed phases would make recover-plan reject.
items.failure: A permitted note in an earlier phase blocks all later frontier recoveries with an Earlier phase changed rejection.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Compare each earlier phase section by its governing comparison projection on schema 1, list the site in section 2.2, and add a fixture.

items.title: Reviewer-authority migration path is unreachable and unspecified
items.reason: The snapshot must belong to the run, be a completed plan-review route, and match --commit, but bound execution runs have no plan-review snapshots and completed source runs only reviewed the pre-migration commit; no focused exclusion review prompt or route exists.
items.failure: The reviewer authority mode advertised by the plan and skill can never succeed, leaving dead code and misleading operator guidance.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Decide whether to define a focused reviewer approval mechanism (run, prompt context, route) or ship operator-only confirmation for this feature and update section 3.3, tests and skill.

items.title: migrate-schema must refuse when expected schema is already 1
items.reason: Replay fails closed on a second migration or fromSchema mismatch, but the command does not check the run is still schema 0; a sequential second migration with a new digest appends and permanently invalidates the append-only chain.
items.failure: A repeated or schema-1-binding migration irreversibly drift-blocks the run with an invalid lineage.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Refuse with PLAN_MIGRATION_CONFLICT before dry-run/write when the binding has planSchema 1, lineage already holds a valid migration, or the source run has a migration record; add tests.

items.title: Exclusion diff alignment and currentText pairing are undefined
items.reason: The digest hashes per-exclusion currentText but the plan never defines how a counterpart is found, and the line diff algorithm is unspecified, so repeated lines give nondeterministic exclusion lists.
items.failure: Dry-run and record can compute different exclusions/digests, or the motivating dry-run cannot show the current status text as required.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Name a deterministic line diff with stable tie-breaking and record one hashed nonGoverningText block of target non-governing lines instead of per-exclusion pairing.

items.title: expectedKeys omits the decisions stream that recover-plan includes
items.reason: Plan claims to match recover-plan, which passes steps, budget and decisions to atomicAppendIfAllNew.
items.failure: A concurrent review decision does not invalidate a migration attempt, unlike recover-plan.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Include the decisions key list in expectedKeys in Design Decisions and section 3.3.

result_json.summary: Well-grounded plan with accurate seams, but schema 1 text-amendment verification still compares raw bytes against lineage anchors so informational edits block all amendments, and the reviewer-authority migration path is unreachable; both need decisions. Remaining items are mechanical.

baselineAssessment.reason: Projection module (~5), schema threading across ~30 drift/parser/span call sites plus bind (~6), dual-entry migration with digest, atomic append, bind integration and refusal rules (~8), assets/templates/skills/acceptance (~5), plus schema-1 text-amendment verification the plan omits (~2-3).

result_json.guidance: Operator approved P0.1: schema-1 amendment guards resolve and verify authorized spans against the shared governing projection (contract minus note blocks, checkbox-normalized). Literal verification only; no semantic comparison. Permit informational edits without invalidating authorization; reject changes outside authorized governing spans and retain budget/structural protections. Keep raw snapshots for provenance; schema 0 unchanged. Operator approved P1.3: ship operator-only confirmation of the exact exclusion digest for selective schema migration; equivalent migration remains mechanically verified. Remove the unreachable reviewer-snapshot authority path from this scope. Address remaining mechanical review findings and reassess affected work items, then continue full review.

result_json.message: Revise plan 216 after the staff review (no addendum): verify schema 1 guards on the governing projection and confirm selective migration with an operator digest only.
docs: update plan review for plan schema contracts and migration

result_json.summary: All seven prior findings are addressed in plan v1.1: projected schema 1 guard verification, space-filled mask with raw-string byte conversion, projected earlier-phase recovery check, operator-only selective migration, second-migration refusal with identical-retry-first, deterministic exclusion diff with nonGoverningText, and decisions in expectedKeys. No revision-causal blockers found.
